item.text:
**Bottom Line**
2024 looks like fragile, partial de-escalation rather than a clear regional improvement. Tshisekedi did keep mediation alive and endorsed ceasefires, but the east remained violent, the Angola talks collapsed in December, and the UN still described ongoing M23 offensives and external military involvement. On balance, I did not find credible evidence that he left regional/international relations more peaceful, stable, and lawful than he inherited them.

**Accepted Claims**
- **Collective effort essential to get DR Congo on firm path to peace** | **UN Office at Geneva** | **2024-09-30** | [source](https://www.ungeneva.org/en/news-media/news/2024/09/98156/collective-effort-essential-get-dr-congo-firm-path-peace)  
  The UN said fighting had notably decreased since the 30 July ceasefire, and that an active DRC-Rwanda dialogue framework existed under Angolan mediation. This is the strongest evidence for temporary improvement.  
  **IDs:** `2B.10`, `2B.7`

- **Democratic Republic of the Congo: 2024 Article IV Consultation, Sixth Review Under the ECF Arrangement** | **IMF** | **2024-07-15** | [source](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/07/15/democratic-republic-of-the-congo-2024-article-iv-consultation-sixth-review-under-the-551892)  
  The IMF said higher security spending was pressuring the budget because of escalating conflict in the east and the gradual UN force withdrawal. This is useful context for inherited constraints: Tshisekedi was operating in a worsening security environment, not a settled one.  
  **IDs:** `2B.10`, `2B.8`

- **Le Président Felix Tshisekedi réclame des sanctions ciblées contre le Rwanda pour mettre fin à la crise sécuritaire à l’Est de la RDC** | **Présidence RDC** | **2024-09-25** | [source](https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/le_president_felix_tshisekedi_reclame_des_sanctions_ciblees_contre_le_rwanda_pour_mettre_fin_a_la_crise_securitaire_a_lest_de_la_rdc)  
  Tshisekedi used his UNGA speech to call for targeted sanctions against Rwanda and framed the crisis as one for international condemnation and lawful pressure, not just unilateral force. That supports a lawful-diplomatic response track, even if it did not solve the conflict.  
  **IDs:** `2B.10`, `2B.6`, `2B.7`

- **Congo and Rwanda say peace talks in Angola will not take place** | **Reuters** | **2024-12-15** | [source](https://www.yahoo.com/news/congo-rwanda-peace-talks-angola-130008004.html)  
  Reuters reported that the planned Angola summit collapsed, dashing hopes of a deal to curb the M23 conflict. This is strong counterevidence against any claim of durable regional stabilization by year-end.  
  **IDs:** `2B.10`, `2B.7`

- **Security Council Renews Mandate of Stabilization Mission in Democratic Republic of Congo** | **UN Press** | **2024-12-20** | [source](https://press.un.org/en/2024/sc15949.doc.htm)  
  The Security Council expressed grave concern over the ongoing M23 offensive in North Kivu, in violation of the ceasefire, and over unauthorized external forces in eastern Congo. That undercuts a net-improvement reading: the regional security order remained unstable and only partially governed by law.  
  **IDs:** `2B.10`, `2B.5`, `2B.7`

- **Congolese president sacks military top brass in major reshuffle** | **Reuters** | **2024-12-20** | [source](https://theprint.in/world/congolese-president-sacks-military-top-brass-in-major-reshuffle/2411531/)  
  Tshisekedi replaced the army chief, military intelligence head, and many senior officers while fighting in the east still flared and hopes for a Rwanda deal had dimmed. This is best read as a late corrective response to instability, not evidence that the region had already become more stable.  
  **IDs:** `2B.10`, `2B.8`, `2B.9`

**Search Gap**
I did not find credible evidence of a durable, year-end regional settlement or a clear net reduction in conflict and illegality beyond the temporary July ceasefire and subsequent diplomacy. The best 2024 evidence supports “partial, fragile de-escalation under severe inherited constraints,” not a clear overall improvement.
